description: This file defines a class 'TableChooserTreeNode' that extends 'DefaultMutableTreeNode'. It is part of a Swing UI component for representing nodes in a tree structure related to tables in the RomRaider project.

classes.name: TableChooserTreeNode
classes.description: A tree node class for holding a table object and displaying text within a Swing JTree component.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the node with display text and associated table object.
